Step: 1462 is not a leap year (divisible by 2 but not by 4).  
01-27-1462 + 18 weeks = 01-27-1462 + 126 days = May 33? Actually: Jan 27 + 126 days → Jan has 31 days, so Jan 27 + 4 days = Jan 31, then Feb (28 days) → Mar 4, then Mar (31) → Apr 4, then Apr (30) → May 4. Wait, 126 days total:  
From Jan 27: Jan 27 to Jan 31 = 4 days, Feb = 28 days (total 32), Mar = 31 (total 63), Apr = 30 (total 93), need 126 total, so 126 - 93 = 33 days into May → May 33 = June 2.  
Then add 2 days → June 4, 1462.
